body: Owner, 2026-10-08: "just do the recommend for now", choosing "The 3 open decisions (Recommended)". A held lock makes Trash and Purge by anyone but the owner (and sweeps with no actor) return ErrLocked, so a checked-out file cannot vanish under its editor; Store.PurgeScope still bypasses locks for tenant offboarding (docs/plugins/locks.md).
title: Locks keep blocking Trash and Purge
